summary_of_reviews: The Razr 2023 is highly praised for its innovative folding design, beautiful screen, and fast performance. Guests appreciate its compact size, making it easy to carry, and the high-quality photos it takes. Some concerns include sound quality during calls and the lack of an SD card slot. Overall, it is considered a durable and stylish phone with a long-lasting battery.

I?m putting it to good use since all gyms are closed. 5 stars.","value_name":"Power Tower to sweet to be sour."},{"value":"Its a stable/sturdy power tower.The arc o-rings will cut into the paint when you tighten the bolts. There we scratches on 4 or more of my parts. I am upset with the shipping / unboxing, but I think the overall product will be good. The pullup bar is a bit thicker than I expected, so my teeter hangups will not work. Given the scratched and removing paint, I hope it holds up in Seattle weather.","value_name":"Paint Chipped, End Caps Broken"},{"value":"After owning 2 indoor home pull up/dip stations, this one is the most sturdy and stable I have owned. I have it set up outside on my concrete back yard patio and it is stable enough for what I use it for that I don't need to bolt it down. I lined the bottom with rubber garage door weather seal. I weigh 165 lbs. and use it regularly for weighted pull ups and dips, hanging leg/knee raises, toe to bar, windshield wipers, and oblique abdominal sit ups. However, if you plan on performing any plyometric exercises on it that require you to change your grips mid-air, then you should definitely bolt it down. As for the height, I'm 5'10\" and it works fine for me. If you're over 6 feet, it might seem short if you do hanging leg/knee raises or pull ups (you would have to keep your knees bent). The only minor issues I had was that the shipping box came pretty beat up and some of the pieces came with a few scratches/chips. Also, the black caps were the only pieces that didn't seem to fit \"perfectly.\" They fit okay, but they kind of pop out a little occasionally. The diameter of the pull up bar is thicker than the typical ones you find in gyms and parks, which makes it more challenging, but I consider that a good thing. Keep in mind, this product does not have bars for neutral grip pull ups. The directions were clear and assembly was easy (all of the pieces/bolts fit well, I was able to hand tighten everything at first and then used the allen key to tighten everything at the end). As the directions say, don't tighten anything until the last step. Overall, I'm very satisfied with the product. I no longer need to lug my pull/dip chain belt and weight vest to the park to do my workouts and I can keep it outside with taking up indoor space.","value_name":"Sturdy and stable outdoor home pull up/dip tower"}]

title: Hillman POWERPRO ONE No. 8 X 1-1/2 in. L Star Flat Head Multi-Material Screw 25 pk
product_description: Engineered for optimum performance in multiple materials Power Pro One screws are the One screw you'll ever need. Developed to outperform and replace standard wood sheet metal and concrete/masonry screws the One Screw program simplifies your tool box by using a single innovative engineered screw design to satisfy projects that fasten into wood metal concrete drywall and plastic. This zinc plated screw is ideal for interior applications; it is not recommended for exterior projects or treated lumber. Its flat head design and star drive provide easy and clean countersinking into wood. Manufactured with spiral flutes serrated hi-lo threads and a 3-sided pyramid point no pre-drilling is required in wood drywall plastic or metal up to 20 gauge thick. Concrete and masonry applications require a pre-drilled a hole see product packaging for pre-drilling instructions. Each package includes a free durable Pro-Stik Star Driver Bit. All One Screw products offer a limited lifetime warranty.

product_description:
Be blown away by the reliable performance of the Hurricane 16-Inch Classic Corded Electric Oscillating Wall Mount Fan, your solution for powerful and space-efficient air circulation. Whether it's your grow tents, apartments, offices, sheds, home garages, small studios, or dorms, this wall fan is designed to deliver exceptional performance. Easily install it with the included heavy-duty wall bracket and hardware, saving valuable floor space.

Crafted with rugged all-metal construction and a sleek white painted finish, this fan exudes durability and style. It also features an option to lock in a static position to limit airflow to one steady direction. Take control of your comfort with the oscillating fan's versatile features. The hanging pull cords mean you can install the fan high on the wall yet still access and control the 3-speed options. Choose from 3 speed settings, allowing you to tailor the airflow to your preference. The 90-degree oscillation controls a customizable experience, ensuring every corner of your space receives optimal ventilation. The included 5-foot, 120-volt power cord adds convenience, giving you flexibility in placement so you can use this as a camper fan, porch fan, or simply as an indoor fan. 

Enhance your environment with the 16-Inch Classic Corded Electric Oscillating Wall Mount Fan from Hurricane where performance, durability, and versatility converge for superior air circulation in any space.

title: Refurbished Apple Watch Ultra GPS + Cellular Titanium Case with Ocean Band (2022, 1st Generation) - Target Certified Refurbished
product_description:
This Target Certified Refurbished product has been refurbished to like-new condition. This is a fully functional product that may show some minor cosmetic blemishes. All functionality have been tested and validated through our rigorous refurbishment process. This product that has passed our comprehensive multi-point inspection test to ensure that it meets our Grade A designation whereby all software, hardware, battery, audio, and video functionality have passed our quality standards.

The most rugged and capable Apple Watch ever, designed for exploration, adventure, and endurance. With a 49mm aerospace-grade titanium case, extra-long battery life,¹ specialized apps that work with the advanced sensors, and a new customizable Action button.

What's in the Box
Ocean Band
USB-C Magnetic Fast Charging Cable

Key Features
Specialized features, sensors, and three new bands designed for exploration, adventure, and endurance
49mm aerospace-grade titanium case for an ideal balance of weight, strength, and corrosion resistance
The largest, brightest Apple Watch display for improved legibility in all conditions
Up to 36 hours of battery life for normal use along with low-power settings for even longer battery life¹
Precision dual-frequency GPS system provides accurate location for calculating distance, pace, and route maps
Water resistant 100m²
Greater operating temperature tolerances while on-wrist to accommodate incredibly diverse environments
Customizable Action button can mark a Compass Waypoint, start Backtrack, mark segments in a workout, turn on the flashlight, and more
Advanced safety features, including Siren, Backtrack, Fall Detection, Emergency SOS,³ and Crash Detection
Improved Workout app with new metrics, new views, and advanced ways to train
A completely redesigned Compass app with waypoints and Backtrack
Depth gauge and water temperature sensor activates automatically when you submerge
Made for recreational scuba diving and free diving down to 40 meters⁴
Included cellular lets you stay connected to people and information you care about most ⁵
Advanced health sensors let you take an ECG⁶ and measure heart rate, track temperature changes⁷ for insights into menstrual cycles,⁸ and measure blood oxygen⁹
Track your daily activity on Apple Watch, and see your trends in the Fitness app on iPhone
Stream or sync your favorite music, podcasts, and audiobooks
Make purchases instantly and securely from your wrist with Apple Pay¹⁰
watchOS 9 features an enhanced Workout app, a new Medications app, sleep stages, and greater insights into heart health
Apple Watch comes with 3 free months of Apple Fitness+, featuring 11 different workout types, from HIIT to Yoga, and even meditations¹¹

Technical specifications
Go to apple.com/watch/compare for a complete set.

Legal
Apple Watch Ultra requires an iPhone 8 or later with iOS 16 or later.
¹Battery life varies by use and configuration. See apple.com/batteries for more information.
²Apple Watch Ultra has a water resistance rating of 100 meters under ISO standard 22810. It may be used for recreational scuba diving (with compatible third-party app from the App Store) to 40 meters and high-speed water sports. Apple Watch Ultra should not be used for diving below 40 meters. Water resistance is not a permanent condition and can diminish over time. For additional information, see support.apple.com/HT205000.
³Emergency SOS requires a cellular connection or Wi-Fi Calling with an internet connection from your Apple Watch or nearby iPhone.
⁴A subscription is required for Oceanic+. Available on the App Store. Always follow diving protocols, dive with a companion, and have a secondary device.
⁵Wireless service plan required for cellular service. Contact your service provider for more details. Connection may vary based on network availability. Check apple.com/watch/cellular for participating wireless carriers and eligibility. See support.apple.com/en-us/HT207578 for additional setup instructions.
⁶The ECG app and irregular rhythm notification require the latest versions of watchOS and iOS and are not intended for use by people under 22 years old. The ECG app is available on Apple Watch Series 4 or later (not including Apple Watch SE). The irregular rhythm notification is not designed for people who have been previously diagnosed with Afib.
⁷The temperature sensing feature is not a medical device and is not intended for use in medical diagnosis, treatment, or for any other medical purpose.
⁸The Cycle Tracking app should not be used as a form of birth control. Data from the Cycle Tracking app should not be used to diagnose a health condition.
⁹Blood Oxygen app measurements are not intended for medical use, including self-diagnosis or consultation with a doctor, and are only designed for general fitness and wellness purposes.
¹⁰Apple Pay is not available in all markets. For a list of Apple Pay countries and regions, visit support.apple.com/en-us/HT207957.
¹¹A subscription is required for Apple Fitness+.

title: Monoprice Premium Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket Low Profile For 60" To 100" TVs up to 176lbs, Max VESA 900x6
product_description:
Don't leave your flat panel TV on a table or stand where it can be knocked over and damaged, or even worse injure a child or pet. Instead, mount it securely and safely to the wall using this full motion TV wall mount bracket from Monoprice!

This mount bracket supports adjustments in four dimensions; it can be swiveled 45 degree;, can be tilted to -15/+5 degree, and can be rotated 3 degree for fine level adjustments. Additionally, it can be extended from a minimum distance to the wall of 2.8 inch to a maximum of 24.6 inch.

This bracket is designed to mount an LCD, LED, or Plasma display with a VESA mounting pattern between 200x200 and 600x900, which includes most 60 to 100 inches TVs. It can be mounted to any type wall (brick, concrete, wood stud, etc.) and can safely hold up to 176 lbs (including the weight of the mount itself). Mounting hardware is included.

Note that the display screen size is only an approximation. Your display is compatible with this mount as long as it has a VESA mounting pattern and weight that fit within the size and weight limits listed above.

30-day easy returns. No restocking fee. Free lifetime technical support. 1 year warranty.

summary_of_reviews: The Monoprice TV mount is a sturdy, well-built unit that offers a full range of motion and is capable of holding large, heavy TVs. It is praised for its robust construction, easy installation, and reasonable price. However, some guests found the mounting design to be problematic, with issues related to hole spacing and difficulty in adjusting the tilt. The mount is also reported to be heavy, which might require two people for installation.

summary_of_reviews: The Revlon Colorstay Limitless Matte Liquid Lipstick offers a range of shades with a matte finish that guests appreciate for its long-lasting wear and pigmentation. While some guests find the formula to be drying, others praise its staying power through meals and its lightweight feel. The product's precision applicator is also noted for its ease of use, though removal can be challenging for some. Overall, it's a product that stands out for its durability and vibrant color payoff, suitable for various occasions.

what_customers_said: [{"value":"This is a nicely designed and constructed cooler bag that would be great for small picnics or bringing home smaller frozen groceries (frozen dinners and ice cream, but not full-size frozen pizzas). Compared to other cooler bags I have seen, this one has a lot of thoughtful features — an adjustable shoulder strap, sturdy handles, a small zipper pocket, mesh pockets on both ends, an easy-access mini-opening on top, adjustable straps to hold a towel or mat, and even an attached bottle opener. The exterior material feels very durable, the construction seems solid, the webbing feels strong and well-attached, and the zippers feel sturdy. I did not fill it with water to test whether it is 100% leakproof, but the seams look and feel solid. When not in use, the cooler does fold somewhat, but the thick padding prevents it from folding anywhere close to “flat.” (I’ll just put a big rubber band around it when it’s sitting empty in the trunk of my car.) This cooler bag is high-quality and a useful “in-between” size.","value_name":"Nicely constructed, versatile medium-sized cooler bag"}]

title: 5pc Patio Dining Set with 36" Square Acacia Table and  Chairs - Captiva Designs
product_description:
[CAPTIVA DESIGNS] This set is a convenient package that includes a robust black steel dining table with wood-like tabletop, seating for four, and an umbrella hole. Crafted with ergonomic right angle armrests, these chairs ensure durability and unparalleled relaxation. Soft, removable cushions add extra comfort, while easy assembly and minimal maintenance make enjoying your outdoor space effortless. Embrace nature's beauty with selective wicker, creating an inviting space for lasting gatherings.Resistant to rust, weather, and fading, it is suitable for indoors and outdoors, with easy assembly and maintenance for hassle-free enjoyment.

FEATURES
Wood-Like Table Top for an elegant appearance.
1.57" Umbrella Hole for shade on sunny days.
All-weather wicker chairs for extra relaxation.
Removable Soft Cushions are easy to clean and remove.
Ergonomic right angle armrests for unparalleled comfort.
E-coating and Powder-Coated Steel Frame for a sturdy centerpiece.

SPECIFICATION
Dining Table: 28"H x 37"W x 37"L, 26.4" (floor to apron height)

Arm Chair: 34.4"H x 23.8"W x 26.4"D, 20.5" (seat back height)
Seat Dimensions: 19.7"W x 19.7"D, Cushion Thickness: 2"
Floor to seat top: 16.1" (cushion not included), Floor to armrest: 24.4"

Package Includes
1 x dining table
4 x rattan chairs
Instruction Manuals (come with each box)
(Decorations on the table are not included)

Tips: Allow all the holes in the section to line up correctly and then tighten the screws.
Assembly: 30 minutes to set up the table and about 40 minutes to put the chairs together.

title: DampRid Moisture Absorber Air Freshener Fresh Scent - 15.8oz
product_description: Don’t just cover up odors, eliminate them with DampRid Reusable Moisture Absorber with Drop-In Tablet. The 360-degree ventilation system enhances airflow, making it our fastest acting moisture absorber. To use, simply insert an unwrapped tablet into the top of the moisture collection unit. DampRid crystals absorb excess moisture out of the air without use of electricity or batteries, while preventing moisture damage to your valuable possessions. Time-Release Fragrance Technology releases a pleasant scent over the life of the product. Place these moisture absorbers in closets, bathrooms, laundry rooms, pantries, storage units, basements, garages, stored boats and RVS – anywhere damp, stagnant air is a problem. When tablet has dissolved, empty liquid in toilet or drain and rinse out container residue before refilling with new tablet. DampRid Moisture Absorber Drop-In Tablet Refill packs are sold separately. Refill tablets are available in Fresh Scent and Fragrance Free. Keep out of reach of children and do not use in moving vehicles. Read and follow all label directions.

product_description: When it comes to washable rugs, Ruggable stands out from the pack. Our products are thoughtfully designed and created to withstand whatever life throws at them: dirt, dust, spills, and even pet accidents. We’re the first brand to offer fully machine washable rugs, making it easy and affordable to keep your rugs clean. We've sold our high quality, two-piece system to millions of customers and counting. Our low-pile, flatwoven washable rugs feature a non-toxic, water-resistant barrier that shields your floors from everyday stains, spills, and unwanted odors. Our rug pads features non-slip latex-free backing to keep your rug in place. What's the Ruggable difference? Durable Construction & Washability: Our rugs look new again after each wash. Long Lasting Spill-Resistant Protection: Water resistant protection that doesn't deteriorate after washing. Non-Slip Grip that Stays: Our 2-piece system allows the non-slip grip to stay out of the washing machine and your rug to stay in place. Ruggable rugs are pet-friendly, kid-friendly, and life friendly: No stress over spills, soft for tiny toes & paws, and safe & non-toxic.

title: Ostrich On-Your-Back Outdoor Reclining Beach Lounge Pool Camping Chair
product_description:
Finally read and tan your back in total comfort with easy transport! The Ostrich On-Your-Back Chair (OYB) is quickly becoming one of the most popular products in the line of Ostrich Chairs, great for camping, outdoor sports, and more! 

With the patented open/close face cavity, armholes, this outdoor folding chair allows you to comfortably lie on your back or stomach, perfect for poolside hangouts or laying out at the beach. Using the 5-position adjustability, you get to select the best position for soaking up the sun, sitting on your patio, or watching the game. Designed with an extra-wide seat, the recliner chair offers additional room and comfort. Thanks to the sturdy aluminum frame, the outdoor chair can support up to 325 pounds and resists rust for long-lasting use. The armrests add style to function while the PVC polyester fabric ensures durability through your adventures whether you're out camping, going to sports events, or simply hanging out in your backyard. Should you get thirsty, this tanning chair has a convenient cup holder to keep your beverage nearby. When you're ready to go, the portable chair folds up and includes backpack straps for easy, hands-free transport.

Versatile, comfortable, and conveniently portable, the Ostrich On-Your-Back Chair is your go-to companion for all of your outdoor adventures!

product_description:
Smell better everywhere with Lume Whole Body Deodorant for Pits, Privates and Beyond.

Armpits aren’t the only place we have odor, and Lume is uniquely made to control ALL external body odor. One deodorant is all you need for underarms, underboobs, private parts, skinfolds and creases, belly buttons, and feet.

Our science based approach has raised the bar for personal hygiene. Lume Whole Body Deodorant for women is pH optimized to block odor before it starts. Certain traditional deodorants simply mask or neutralize odor after it forms.

Pair Lume Whole Body Deodorant for women with our Acidified Body Wash and Acidified Wipes, and you will be an odor free powerhouse from head to toe.

About Lume:
As a practicing OB/GYN with a deep understanding of women’s anatomy, body chemistry, and how detrimental body odor can be to confidence, Dr. Shannon Klingman had a suspicion that the common concern of odor below the belt was being overdiagnosed as Bacterial Vaginosis (BV). She discovered that the vagina is not usually to blame for day to day odor, and that women needed an external solution—not antibiotics or douches—to control external body odor in the right way.

Kitchen-made prototypes turned into clinically backed, outrageously effective deodorant designed to go where no others dare—anywhere body odor exists. And so, the first Whole Body Deodorant with 72 hour odor control was born.

product_description:
Enjoy comforting temperatures in your home during those dreaded winter months. The Infrared Space Heater from LifeSmart will be sure to satisfy your heating needs while you're watching movies or working in the basement. 

This indoor space heater is much like the infrared heating inside a toaster and is meant to heat objects in the room while providing a more natural warmth that won't dry out the air. Infrared heaters are designed to work in addition to your home's heating system. Designed to heat rooms up to 1500 square feet in size, you can be sure that everyone in the room will remain comfortable. Including 3 heating systems, smart programming, and remote controls, this warmer can accommodate whatever heating temperature you need. 

Keep you and your room warm and cozy throughout the seasons. Being an ideal addition to your family room, living room, basement, or bedroom, the Indoor Space Heater from LifeSmart will be exactly what you've been looking for.

title: Tangkula Wood Storage Cube Bookcase 3 Tier 8 Cube Open Shelf Storage Cabinet with Anti-Toppling Devices Multipurpose Bookshelf Natural/Burlywood/Oak Grey/White
product_description:
Our 3-tier bookcase boasts 8 cubbies, offering spacious space for storing your belongings, such as books, clothes, ornaments, kid's toys, etc. The open design also provides great convenience for easy fetching and looking up. Made of durable material of thickened board, our wooden bookcase ensures excellent scratch resistance and high sturdiness. Designed with 2 anti-toppling devices, non-slip adhesive pads, and fixed plastic buckles on the back, the storage cabinet enhances overall stability to withstand heavy loads. Apart from being used as a bookcase, it also serves well as a toy storage organizer, and display rack to meet your different needs. You can put it in the living room, bedroom, study, office, kids' room, or reading room. A simple and stylish appearance adds some character to your home style!


Features
  • 8 cubes compartments of 2 sizes for spacious storage space
  • Full open shelves with 10.5-inch high clearance for easy fetching
  • Wide top with elevated edges provides extra storage space
  • Reinforced plastic angle code bracket for better support
  • Premium surface ensures excellent scratch resistance
  • 2 anti-toppling kits for ensured stability and higher security
  • Smooth surface and no-sharp edges prevent accident injuries

    Package Includes:
    1 x Bookcase
    1 x User Guide

title: Tranquillo Universal 106.5" Double Hammock with Adjustable Stand and Bag
product_description:
Unwind and escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life with the Universal Double Hammock from Tranquillo. 

Whether you need a much-deserved nap or a space to immerse in your hobbies, such as reading, this hammock is the ideal spot for maximum relaxation. Crafted of 2-layered breathable polyester materials, 2 people can rest comfortably on the expandable net while the stitched-in spreader bars ensure no uncomfortably cocooning. With the rubber feet stabilizers to minimize scratching, you can set up this resting station anywhere you'd like. 

Equipped with 2 and 3 height adjustments and smooth ball bearings to ensure all rocking movements are flawless and noiseless, this hammock will satisfy all your relaxation needs. The powder-coated steel frame provides increased durability that supports up to 550 pounds. A carry bag is included to conveniently store and transport the hammock stand and net so you can quickly set it up on your next camping adventure or in your home when the time is right. 

Enjoy your moments of relaxation now more than ever with the Tranquillo Universal Double Hammock.

title: Calphalon Premier 8 Quart Hard Anodized Aluminum Nonstick Multi-Pot Cookware with Tempered Glass Lid and Steamer Inserts, Black
product_description:
Cook the best meals for your friends and family with the Calphalon Premier 8-Quart Hard Anodized Aluminum Nonstick Multi-Pot. Featuring MinerShield technology, this pot provides you with ultimate durability. 

The nonstick multi-pot delivers superior, long-lasting performance for effortless food release over and over again, allowing you to cook with confidence as you serve delicate meals with ease. Equipped with a 3-layer nonstick interior, this pan's hard-anodized aluminum withstands metal utensils, while the exterior is dishwasher-safe for simple cleanup. The multi-pot is also oven-safe up to 450 degrees Fahrenheit so that the cookware can go from the stovetop into the oven for heating and cooking versatility. 

Including steamer inserts, this multi-pot provides hassle-free cooking for pasta-like meals. This multi-purpose pot is also ideal for preparing slow-simmered stews, stocks, and braises while the tempered glass lid traps in heat for an efficient cook.

Elevate your cooking experience and enjoy having the Calphalon Premier 8-Quart Nonstick Multi-Pot in your kitchen.

summary_of_reviews: This rug is praised for its high quality, attractive design, and versatility in various spaces. Guests appreciate its soft texture, which is uncommon for jute rugs, and its ability to blend well with different decor styles. title: Northlight Real Touch™️ Pre-Lit Full Flocked Rosemary Emerald Angel Pine Artificial Christmas Tree - 6.5' - Clear LED Lights
product_description:
For the most realistic artificial holiday trees around, choose Northlight Real Touch™ artificial holiday trees. Add a touch of festive elegance to your holiday decor with our pre-lit artificial rosemary emerald pine holiday tree. Delicately flocked with a dusting of snow and adorned with pinecones, this tree captures the timeless charm of a winter wonderland. Its clear LED lights radiate a warm glow, creating a cozy atmosphere for your celebrations. Embrace the magic of the season with this enchanting centerpiece, bringing joy and cheer to your home year after year.

Product Features:
Real Touch™ artificial tree
Flocked
Pre-lit with 500 clear lights 
Bulb size: concave wide angle
Bulb type: LED
1066 tips
1”-3" wide tips
48" green lead cord

Additional Product Features:
LED lights use 90% less energy 
Durable non-glass replaceable bulbs
Bulbs stay cool to the touch 
Full profile tree
Hinged branch construction
UL certified and approved
If one bulb burns out, the rest will stay lit
Lights are equipped with Lamp Lock feature, which makes them replaceable, interchangeable and keeps them from falling out
3-piece easy assembly (including stand)
Comes with a FREE metal tree stand
Comes with replacement bulbs and spare fuse
Wire gauge: 22
120 volts, 60 hertz, .54 amps, 6.48 watts
For indoor use only
 
Dimensions: 6.5’ high (from the base of the stand to the top of the tree)
Distance from floor to the first row of branches: 12"
44” base diameter (at the widest point)

Material(s): PVC/PE/metal/plastic bulbs/wire

Note: Branches are compressed for shipment, and need to be fluffed out upon arrival to look like the photo

title: Lume Whole Body Women's Deodorant - Invisible Cream Tube - Aluminum Free - Peony Rose Scent - 2.2oz
product_description:
Smell better everywhere with Lume Whole Body Deodorant for Pits, Privates and Beyond.

Armpits aren’t the only place we have odor, and Lume is uniquely made to control ALL external body odor. One deodorant is all you need for underarms, underboobs, private parts, skinfolds and creases, belly buttons, and feet.

Our science based approach has raised the bar for personal hygiene. Lume Whole Body Deodorant for women is pH optimized to block odor before it starts. Certain traditional deodorants simply mask or neutralize odor after it forms.

Pair Lume Whole Body Deodorant for women with our Acidified Body Wash and Acidified Wipes, and you will be an odor free powerhouse from head to toe.

About Lume:
As a practicing OB/GYN with a deep understanding of women’s anatomy, body chemistry, and how detrimental body odor can be to confidence, Dr. Shannon Klingman had a suspicion that the common concern of odor below the belt was being overdiagnosed as Bacterial Vaginosis (BV). She discovered that the vagina is not usually to blame for day to day odor, and that women needed an external solution—not antibiotics or douches—to control external body odor in the right way.

Kitchen-made prototypes turned into clinically backed, outrageously effective deodorant designed to go where no others dare—anywhere body odor exists. And so, the first Whole Body Deodorant with 72 hour odor control was born.

title: Radio Flyer 415PS Kids Readily Assembled Fold 2 Go Trike with Storage Bin
product_description:
Start your little one's biking journey with the Radio Flyer Fold 2 Go Pink Trike. With an easy-to-fold function and easy-carrying handle grip, your little tyke can learn to ride anywhere they want.

The tricycle's low center-of-gravity and controlled turning radius provides stability and prevents tipping to make sure each riding experience is safe. No need to worry about carrying all of your toddler's toys, as this trike has a spacious storage bin to carry them as they ride along. The tricycle also comes with quiet riding wheels that provide a wonderful experience for both parents and children. 

This outdoor trike features a steel-constructed structure for added stability and durability, giving you many uses for years to come. The tricycle's seat is adjustable and therefore as your child keeps growing, they won't have to outgrow the trike as easily. Let's not forget about style. Included with the trike are handlebar streamers, so your little rider can stroll in style.

Before you know it you'll be taking off the training wheels, but for now, savor the beginning with Radio Flyer's Pink Fold 2 Go Trike.

title: Sterilite 2 Bushel Ultra Laundry Basket, Large, Plastic with Comfort Handles to Easily Carry Clothes to and from the Laundry Room
product_description:
Make laundry day easy with this set of 6 Sterilite Ultra 2-Bushel 71-Liter Laundry Baskets. With a generous 2-bushel (71-liter) capacity, these laundry baskets make it easy to carry, sort, and fold clothes, towels, and sheets. This package includes 12 laundry baskets.

Each of these large laundry baskets has wide, rectangular openings that make for the comfortable loading and unloading of large amounts of laundry. 

Easily carry your clothes baskets from room to room thanks to the 4 newly-designed handles that offer a comfortable carrying grip at any angle. The laundry bins also have sturdy rims that provide added strength.

When not in use, these laundry baskets stack neatly and nest together creating more efficient storage space in your home. The large, square hole pattern increases airflow for added ventilation and matches any home decor style. 

Overall, each plastic laundry basket measures approximately 27 inches long, 19 inches wide, and 12 inches tall.

Look forward to laundry day with this set of 6 Sterilite Ultra 2-Bushel 71-Liter Laundry Baskets.

product_description: Semicircle jewelry organizer is a real beauty meets function item prefect for travel!. Masterfully designed with various pockets, partitions and holes, you can store different jewelry types with ease. It is purposed with 6 ring slots, 3 necklace hooks, 1 elastic pocket, 14 earring holes, 1 mirror, and 4 storage spaces separated by removable dividers. Removable dividers could be detached to enlarge the storage space to store bigger pieces such as lipsticks, watches, and the likes. It can hold rings, bracelets, necklaces, earrings, keys, watches and other trinkets to free up clutter from your vanity table. Compact size is very portable and lightweight which is a great travel companion to bring anywhere you go. Easy to carry in your handbag or luggage. Having a vanity mirror is such a perk. You can always look your best for putting on makeup or wearing your jewelries on the go. Crafted from high quality PU leather, the organizer is a durable casing for your treasures. Sturdy zipper ensures the casing is locked and no trinkets could slip out and be misplaced. Delightful gift for women, girls, a bridesmaid, mother, friend, or a lover. Such thoughtful and charming item surely will be treasured especially on occasions like Valentines, engagement, wedding, anniversary, Christmas, or birthday. Color: White. Dimensions: 3.94" x 3.94" x 2.17". This item is a jewelry holder only. Rings, bracelets, and any jewelries are not included.

title: Arches & Halos Angled Brow Shading Pencil - 0.012oz
product_description:
Build a better brow with the retractable Angled Brow Shading Pencil! The specially designed tip is a triple threat to define, detail and shade your brow. The versatility of the tip allows you to apply the product easier and is great to building on the brow. Use the soft custom spoolie to perfectly blend any harsh lines for a natural looking finish. If you're looking for a bigger, thicker brow this is the mechanical pencil for you!

TIP: Beginning at the tip of your nostril use the pencil to measure from this point to the inner corner of your brow and mark a dot. Then the length of the brow is found by diagonally laying the pencil from the nose to the end corner of the eye and mark. Connect the dots on the lower line and repeat on the top. It's so easy, with a little practice! You got this!

summary_of_reviews: The Duke Cannon Sawtooth 2-in-1 Hair Wash is praised for its masculine, woodsy scent and effective cleaning properties. product_description: Scotts Turf Builder Grass Seed Sun & Shade Mix thrives in a variety of conditions. This mix contains Root-Building Nutrition, a combination of ingredients that is expertly crafted to help establish deep roots to grow thick, green turf so that you can build a better, stronger lawn from the roots up. Scotts Turf Builder Grass Seed Sun & Shade Mix is designed for full sun and dense shade, and has medium drought resistance with medium to high durability. It can be used to seed a new lawn or overseed an existing lawn. For best results, apply in the spring or fall when daily average soil temperatures are consistently between 55F and 70F or air temperatures are between 60F and 80F. We recommend using a Scotts spreader to apply this product (please refer to spreader settings on product label). Water daily or as needed to keep the soil surface moist until the seedlings reach at least 2 inches tall. One 16 lb. bag of Scotts Turf Builder Grass Seed Sun & Shade Mix has a new lawn coverage of 2,130 sq. ft. and an overseeding coverage of 6,400 sq. ft.

summary_of_reviews: Splat hair dye is a popular choice for at-home color enthusiasts. It offers a range of vibrant colors that are long-lasting, yet the color results can be inconsistent. The product is easy to use, comes with its own bleach kit, and does not leave the hair feeling gross. However, the dye can be messy, staining the skin and other surfaces, and some guests report hair damage. The amount of bleach provided is often insufficient, particularly for longer or thicker hair. Despite these drawbacks, many users are loyal to the brand and appreciate the affordability and variety of colors.

title: Good Ideas Impressions Riverwalk 50-Gallon Faux Slate Surface Dual Spigot Locations Rain Barrel w/2 Brass Spigots & Screen
product_description:
Imagine a rain barrel that not only captures the pure essence of Mother Nature but also advances the art of rain harvesting to a whole new level. With this Impressions Riverwalk 50-gallon Rain Saver from Good Ideas, this rain barrel isn't just functional, it's a masterpiece of sustainability.

Boasting an exclusive slate rock texture, the plastic container garners compliments from your neighbors as well as adding a touch of natural beauty to your outdoor space, turning your garden into a work of art. But this rain barrel isn't just about looks, it's also a remarkable example of high functionality. A meticulously meshed screen stands guard, blocking debris from entering your water supply, ensuring that every drop collected is as pure as the day it fell from the sky.

Built to last, its 2 robust brass spigots remain immune to rust or breakage, guaranteeing a dependable and enduring rainwater dispensing solution. This rain barrel comes equipped with a routed channel that ingeniously diverts excess water to the front of the barrel, making sure your home's foundation stays dry while your garden thrives. Thanks to its dual spigot locations you have the flexibility to decide how you wish to utilize the rainwater you've gathered. With spigots positioned at both high and low points on the barrel, watering your plants or filling your watering can has never been more convenient.

If you aim to express your lifestyle with conviction, the Impressions Riverwalk 50-gallon Rain Saver by Good Ideas becomes your canvas for embracing sustainable living.

With a simple touch, you can transform your space into a private oasis where worries dissipate.

Including built-in cupholders and a reinforced, insulated pool cover that locks in heat while not in use, you can be sure this spa is ready for when you are. Escape away to loosen your muscles with the Bestway SaluSpa Plus Milan Hot Tub Spa.

summary_of_reviews: The Kennewick 8 Light Chandelier by Kichler is a beautiful and versatile lighting fixture that has received high praise for its elegant design, quality materials, and ease of installation. Guests appreciate its ability to enhance various spaces, from dining rooms to entryways, with sufficient lighting and a timeless look. Some concerns were raised about the material quality and installation complexity.

Such fun and good replay value.","value_name":"Skywalker Saga!"},{"value":"Get ready for freezing cut scenes, unplayable white screens, missing action prompts, and incredibly long load times. This game was clearly made for the PS5 and Xbox, the Switch version is a unpolished eye straining dumpster fire for the senses. It takes a lot of love for the franchise to look past the problems this version has. Don’t get mad at me for this, I’d love to rate the game simply for the game play. But not in this new age we live in where developers feel it’s okay to put out unfinished games at full price. No more pre orders for me.","value_name":"This Game is a Mess"},{"value":"I was so incredibly excited to see that lego Star Wars was coming back, and I preordered it on switch. However; on the morning of the release, I start up the game, watch through the opening animations and start a new save, only to have all excitement drain from me. The cantina and other hubs are replaced with a plain episode selection screen, no fun music or wandering through the hubs, just choose an episode and go for it. I decide to start with phantom menace, as I really enjoyed the prequels in the original game, and get a 10 second segment piloting the ship carrying Obi-wan and Qui-gon, and it gets worse. Level design has been completely forgone in favor of bland “open-world gameplay”, in which you wander from story point to story point, occasionally grabbing collectibles, blasting through the story with short escort quests and fights, the joys that used to come with collecting studs to get true Jedi and finding mini-kits, and playing through interesting, fun levels are lost in favor of the novelty of the open-world. When we do get levels that feel like the old game, they are short-lived and far between. Another strange aspect that was needlessly added to increase grinding and playtime is the RPG style upgrade system, random skills that can be raised to change gameplay, interesting but ultimately a waste of time. In short, this game lacks all the charm of the original and just feels hallow to play.","value_name":"Incredibly disappointing"},{"value":"This isn’t really a game review and more of my opinion on the deluxe version with exclusive Luke Skywalker. It being sold out is just crazy because lego/TT Games had all this time to produce copies of the deluxe edition and on release day you can’t find a copy unless you already pre-ordered it but at least you can still get the base game. Hopefully they produce more but who knows whom ever else got the deluxe copy you’re lucky.","value_name":"Good game. title: Sterilite 15273V04 Tuff1 Latching 30 Gallon Plastic Stackable Temperature & Impact Resistant Storage Tote Container Bin with Lid, Gray (12 Pack)
product_description:
Take advantage of that storage space in basements, garages, or attics with the rugged Sterilite Tuff1 Latching 30-Gallon Storage Tote. These 12 storage bins feature durability and strength for added peace of mind that contents will stay safely stored inside. 

The 30-gallon storage containers make a great solution for storing away camping supplies, sporting equipment, and seasonal items in more challenging environments. Made from polyethylene plastic, these storage totes are rugged and impact-resistant even in colder temperatures, making them ideal for more active storage needs. 

Contoured end panels and integrated handles make for a comfortable grip when carrying. The latches offer extra security so the lid and your items stay in place. The deeply recessed lids allow multiple storage totes to stack securely for efficient use of vertical space. The overall dimensions of each storage container are about 30 inches long, 20 inches wide, and 18 inches tall.

Keep all your items neat and organized with this bundle of Sterilite Tuff1 Latching 30 Gallon Plastic Storage Tote Containers.

I have used stainless steel in the past and the weight of the cookware is one of the biggest turnoffs. I was wonderfully surprised that all the Wolfgang pieces are comparable to the weight of nonstick. Not heavy at all! Another wonderful surprise was how many pieces came in this. The lids can be shared amongst the pieces too, which I like so everything can be covered if needed. The knife set comes in an engraved wooden box. If you already have a knife set you love, regifting this would be a beautiful gift. I have not yet cooked in the cookware, but from previous experience I know greasing the pans will absolutely be necessary since they are not nonstick. I also have experienced stainless steel cooking food faster, I’m not sure if this cookware will do the same. Just something I figured I would share if you are unfamiliar with stainless steel. product_description: Your dog deserves the absolute best — like quality dog food with simple ingredients and essential nutrients that you can trust. When average chicken dog food just doesn't cut it, serve your four-legged family member his or her very own version of a classic chicken and veggies meal. Rachael Ray Nutrish Natural Premium Dry Dog Food, Real Chicken & Veggies Recipe is a delicious, dog-friendly take on a savory chicken and veggies dinner. This premium dry dog food recipe is made with simple, natural ingredients, like real U.S. farm-raised chicken, which is always the number one ingredient, combined with wholesome vegetables and added vitamins and minerals. U.S. farm-raised chicken provides high-quality protein to help support lean muscle, and the veggies add fiber to help support healthy digestion. It's a wholesome and satisfying way to show your dog you care while providing 100% complete and balanced nutrition. This premium dog food recipe is Rachael-approved and natural and contains no corn, wheat, soy, gluten, poultry by-products, fillers, artificial flavors or artificial preservatives. Better yet, a portion of your purchase will help support The Rachael Ray Foundation, which helps animals in need get the food, medical supplies, treatments, and more that they may need.

what_customers_said: [{"value":"Before I get into the negatives, lets go over the positives. - good quality - sturdy - somewhat aesthetic - really good instructions! - easy adjustability Negatives - For most people, this thing probably wouldn't take long to put together. If I hadn't spent so much time building the dang thing I would've sent it back, but at this point it'd be more of a pain taking it all apart and trying to pack it back in. - I wish there an additional plug so that I could plug in a lamp and that the top and tray were reversible to that you could use it on either side of the bed - The cord isn't very long so don't plan on trying to move it far from where you have it","value_name":"Not for the inexperienced"}]

product_description: Despite having a simple geometric design and a simple color palette, the Bokhoven Modern Navy Area Rug still catches the eye. The beautiful circle pattern is minimalistic and contemporary. The limited color palette allows you to match the rug to any room's existing color scheme. Really, there is nothing more you would need from a modern area rug. Modern is does not mean boring and this rug is proof of that. A feature that is quite impressive about this area rug is that it is resistant to stains, which makes it much easier to clean than regular rugs. It is suitable for families with pets or children.

As a proven Class II FDA cleared medical device, the PowerDot 2.0 is trusted by everyone from the world’s top athletes, to fitness enthusiasts, and beyond. what_customers_said: [{"value":"I was looking for a good pair of flip-flops as an in-between alternative to my Skechers flip-flops with memory foam foot beds and my basic flip-flops from Old Navy that I can wear both casually out and about and poolside. This pair by Levi's caught my eye for the color options, style, and purposed versitility. I ordered my pair online through the Target website since I have had good experiences ordering from them. I am very satisfied with this pair of flip-flops. They came just as advertized online (which wasn't the case with a pair from another brand that I ordered from another vendor and ended up returning). The straps fit very well and feel secure, and the food beds are comfortable, They are not flimsy. I would highly recommend these flip-flops.","value_name":"Comfortable, Stylish, and Reasonably Priced"}]

Keyboard wrist rest and mouse pad with wrist rest serves as a cushion for your wrists to provide support and improves hand posture while using the computer. Ergonomic contour effectively protects your wrists with its perfectly designed shape and fit. Experience the feathery glide of silky-smooth mouse pad for an excellent user-experience. Its low-friction surface allows for high-speed tracking movements, precision, and accuracy. Smooth surface does not irritate the skin.
Made of slow rebound memory foam, it gently supports your wrists and is suitable for long hours of use. Materials ensure that the wrist rest does not get out of shape easily. Light weight and durable, it is designed to last for a long time. Low maintenance and easy to clean.

* Note: This item is a keyboard and mouse pad wrist rest only. Keyboard and mouse not included.

product_description:

Food stays fresh, dry, and pest free when kept in this container. Built with a large storage capacity of 50 pounds, this 12-inch long by 16.2-inch wide feeder will make an ideal addition to any home. 

Great for both indoor and outdoor use, the Automatic Dog Feeder Chow Hound from Pet Lodge will be sure to become your dog's new best friend.

title: VTech Pop-a-Balls Pop and Surprise Ball Center
product_description: Colorful balls, twisting slides and cheerful animals make playtime fun with the Pop-a-Balls Pop and Surprise Ball Center. The two interactive twisting ball tracks are filled with friendly animals that will stop and start the balls or redirect the rolling. Explore cause and effect relationships by loading the balls into the ball launcher and pressing the big yellow button to send the balls up the tower, where they’ll pop out of three different locations. Press the seesaw to launch the balls onto the slides. The music button introduces colors, animals and plays a variety of melodies. This tower is filled with ball popping fun!

title: MTX Car Audio
product_description:
Enhance your car audio experience with the MTX Audio Terminator Series TNE212D. This exceptional fusion of premium subwoofer and enclosure design surpasses expectations, delivering unrivaled bass performance.

The dual 12-inch sealed enclosure packs a punch with a commanding 1200 watts of maximum power, supported by a consistent 400-watt RMS. Prepare for an audio journey defined by powerful, deep bass that sets a new standard.

This powerhouse includes subwoofers boasting a 2-inch aluminum single 2-ohm voice coil and a robust 48-ounce magnet. These components work in harmony to produce deep, crystal-clear bass. The subwoofers also incorporate Spider Plateau Venting, a mechanical cooling method ensuring continuous air circulation for effective heat dissipation.

We appreciate the challenges of the road, so our subwoofers have tough polypropylene dust caps to handle the trunk's wear and tear. Their lightweight design ensures they move efficiently with low power use, enhancing your audio system's performance.

The enclosure is carefully made from strong 5/8-inch MDF (Medium Density Fiberboard), ensuring the necessary structural integrity for outstanding sound quality. Its black carpet cover not only adds a stylish touch but also keeps your subwoofers securely in position.

With the MTX audio logo and Terminator logo, this subwoofer system combines great performance and style, making your car look and sound better.

title: Nutiva Refined Organic Coconut Oil - 54oz
product_description: Made from organic dried coconut, Nutiva's creamy expeller-pressed Organic Refined Coconut Oil is steam-refined without chemicals. The result is an oil with a neutral scent and flavor that is suitable for all kinds of recipes without worry of your dishes tasting like coconut. With a higher smoke point, refined coconut oil is extremely versatile and can be used as an alternative to butter and other vegetable oils. A solid at cooler temperatures, it becomes liquid when warmed. It can be used for baking, sautéing, stir-frying or anywhere else you would use vegetable oil, shortening or butter. Nutiva Organic Refined Coconut Oil contains 63% medium chain triglycerides (lauric acid, capric acid and caprylic acid), making it ideal for adding more MCT benefits to your diet.

title: Worx Nitro WG751.3 40V Power Share PRO 4.0Ah 20" Cordless Push Lawn Mower, Battery and Charger Included
product_description: The Worx Nitro WG751.2 40V Power Share 20” Push Lawn Mower with Two 4.0Ah High-Capacity Batteries was made to outperform traditional battery and gas-powered lawn mowers. Power Share PRO batteries offer gas-like power, performance, and runtime, but without any of the downsides of using a gas mower. Worx Nitro mowers run cleaner, quieter, and cost less to operate and maintain than gas mowers. And thanks to Power Share PRO batteries, they meet or exceed their performance, too. Worx Nitro mowers are also fully featured. 3-in-1 functionality allows the user to easily switch from mulching to side-discharge to bagging, so depending on the needs of your lawn, you’ll be able to mow it properly. Plus, it’s 20 in. durable steel deck was made to handle lawns with rough terrain, and it’s 19 in. cutting width makes for wide passes while still providing the maneuverability needed to get around bushes, trees, and landscaping. Making cutting height adjustments is easy at well, with just one lever to raise or lower the entire mower from 1.5 in. to 4.5 in. with 7 positions in-between. The bag capacity is 1.4 Bushels, the wheel sizes are 7 in. (front) and 10 in. (rear), and the mower itself weighs 53.6 lbs. with both Power Share PRO batteries installed, and 50.7 lbs bare. The on-board charge level indicator gives the user constant readouts of remaining battery life. While the full-collapsible handle allows for compact stand-up storage and easy transport.

product_description:
Tired of a messy room? The 2-in-1 bookshelf & toy chest will be a great solution!
It features a multi-cube design for classified storage, which is ample to store books, toys, decorations, etc. Plus, overall surface is burr-free & each corner is rounded, so kids won’t be accidentally scratched. Thanks to 4 solid wood legs & anti-tipping kits, the toy chest is super stable. 4" off the floor, the kids bookshelf will stay away from ground dust. More thoughtfully, the open bookshelf is 28" tall, perfect for kids to see & get wanted books & toys. Being placed in the playroom, nursery & bedroom, children’s reading & organization abilities will be highly improved in the long term. Finally, the whole assembly is very simple. It will be a perfect present for kids.


Features
Cleverly combines a bookshelf & a toy chest
A kid-friendly height of 28" for easy access
Up to 5 cubes to offer classified storage
High stability is ensured by anti-tipping kits to the wall
Sturdy wooden structure ensures strong support
4 solid wood legs are elevated to keep away from ground dust
Round corners & smooth edges for safe touching
Anti-falling edges keep items in place
Cultivate good reading habits and keep toys organized
Works well in the reading room, bedroom, playroom, kindergarten and more
Waterproof surface for easy cleaning
Quick assembly guided by a thoughtful manual

title: EcoTools Avocado Oil Infused Gentle Bath + Shower Gloves
product_description:
The EcoTools Gentle Bath + Shower Gloves are infused with moisturizing avocado oil to exfoliate, cleanse, and renew your skin in the bath or shower. Our exfoliating gloves work best with your favorite body wash or body scrub. Just wet the glove and lather up to remove dead skin, dirt, and other impurities all over your body. The gentle exfoliation can also help to prep skin for self-tanner or help to remove self-tan. These bath gloves also have a hanging string for easy storage and drying. Designed with everyone’s needs in mind, EcoTools’ superior assortment of bath and skincare accessories are accessible luxuries, good for you and the planet. Our Gentle Bath + Shower Gloves are made with 100% recycled nylon, and, as with all our EcoTools products, are 100% cruelty-free and vegan.

Directions of Use:
Slip hands in gloves, wet, apply body wash, lather, and massage all over body.

Cleaning, Care, and Maintenance:
Rinse and hang to dry. Replace every 30 days.

For more online video tutorials, plus tips and tricks on how to use our products, visit our YouTube channel.

Nashville Hot is one of our award winning flavors that will satisfy your spicy snack craving throughout the day!

UNIQUELY CRUNCHY: Daily Crunch's sprouted almonds have a hollow core making them crunch like a chip.

WOMAN OWNED: Daily Crunch was started by an aunt and niece duo to bring a healthier and innovative option to the nut snack category.

product_description: Take the next step in your pursuit of the perfect cup. The Scoop® Single-Serve Coffee Maker by Hamilton Beach® brews fresh, delicious coffee in minutes and it's so easy to use. Best of all, The Scoop Single-Serve Coffee Maker doesn't use K-Cup®* pods or paper filters, so it's eco-friendly and easy on your wallet. You can brew a standard 8 oz. cup of coffee or up to 14 oz. into a 7” travel mug — the adjustable cup stand flips up or down to fit your cup. For peace of mind, it automatically turns off after brewing each cup. Features an extra-large brew button with a white brew light and comes with a dishwasher safe, permanent mesh filter for easy cleanup.

Less coffee/tea staining.","value_name":"Works Well"},{"value":"I had used this toothpaste along with the whitening strips for years all throughout my 20's and I loved it. I received compliments frequently from my dentist and others on how white my teeth were. I had decided to make some lifestyle changes in my early 30's and started using more natural, less harsh chemical ridden products for several years (about 6). Discontinuing crest toothpaste and whitening strips during that time. I recently started to add a few products back in my routine that I had used previously. Crest 3D white toothpaste was one of them. I had no problems with this toothpaste in the past however, throughout the 8 months of using crest 3D white toothpaste I started to have problems with angular chelitis, dry mouth, and red/dry irritated lips. Over some time the angular chelitis started occuring every couple of weeks, taking longer to heal each time. I have discovered that it was infact the Crest toothpaste that was causing these unsightly and painful cracks on the corner of my mouth that took forever to heal! I always stay well hydrated and use quality lip moisturizer religiously. Maybe the ingredients have changed over the years?? But, this toothpaste is no good! title: Bestway SaluSpa Hollywood EnergySense Luxe AirJet Round Inflatable 4 to 6 Adult Hot Tub with Heater, Filter, 2 Covers, and 140 AirJet System
product_description:
Enjoy ultimate relaxation while sitting in the Bestway SaluSpa Hollywood EnergySense Luxe AirJet Inflatable Hot Tub. The spacious, round design of this spa provides a soothing massage experience for up to 6 people. Simply attach the pump and watch as it inflates. 

Featuring an AirJet system with 140 jets and 2 intensity levels, this spa releases warm air into the water, surrounding you with a calming bubble massage. This spa reaches up to 104 degrees Fahrenheit to provide the ideal temperature for your soaking needs. The winterizing technology can also keep the spa at the ideal temperature to help prevent damage.

Built with a 3-layer DuraPlus liner and tough materials, you can ensure that this spa will retain its shape and resist tears and punctures for lasting durability. Including a Freeze Shield with an automatic heating function, the inner components will not freeze during colder temperatures so you can have peace of mind when the temperature drops. With an included ChemConnect dispenser, 2 covers, and a repair patch, you've got everything you need to upkeep your spa season after season while the spa pump provides a fast and easy setup.

After a long day, there’s nothing more relaxing than sinking into warm, bubbling water right in your backyard with the SaluSpa Hollywood EnergySense Luxe AirJet Inflatable Hot Tub from Bestway.

ELECTRICAL SAFETY: Do NOT use an extension cord or multi-plug adaptor; plug the hot tub directly into a grounded socket corresponding to the electrical rating of the attachment plug (110-120V AC, 60Hz, Single Phase 12A at 68ºF). Outdoor installation is preferred; indoor installation has special requirements

product_description:
Upgrade your swimming pool with the Vinyl Works Adjustable 24 Inch Above Ground Pool Ladder. This taupe pool ladder is a fantastic addition to any above-ground pool, it adjusts from 48 inches to 56 inches. This ladder is versatile, providing you with a safe and secure way to enter and exit your pool. 

This pool ladder offers a broad platform and extra-wide steps for a comfortable ascent and descent. For added stability, the Vinyl Works Pool Ladder includes two deck mount flanges, ensuring it stays firmly in place during use with a latching gate that offers an extra layer of security, particularly beneficial for families with small children, as it prevents unauthorized access to the pool. The ladder can also be used with an above-ground pool deck platform with up to 4.5-foot side walls and a flat bottom, providing a seamless integration with your existing pool setup. Crafted with durability in mind, this ladder boasts a construction of maintenance-free plastic and sturdy stainless steel hardware. It's engineered to support a maximum capacity of up to 300 pounds, guaranteeing reliability for your entire household.


The Vinyl Works Adjustable Above-Ground Pool Ladder is a must-have for any above-ground pool. It provides safety, comfort, and convenience, making your swimming experience enjoyable and worry-free.

If you are looking for such a high chair, this will be your best choice!

Easy to assemble with detailed instruction and all hardware delivered

The keycaps are designed so that the backlight shines through the center of the keys, illuminating them evenly with backlight in static on/off mode. The Retro Classic is built to fully support both Mac® and PC interfaces and comes with an extra set of easily swappable PC keycaps._

title: Tirrinia Neck Flap Sun Hat for Adults - Fishing Safari Hiking Cap
product_description:
This innovative headwear is meticulously crafted from a premium blend of protective micro-fiber and breathable mesh materials, ensuring optimal comfort and durability for all your outdoor adventures. Its intelligent design caters to a wide range of head sizes with an easily adjustable strap, embodying the concept of 'one size fits most.'
The moisture-dispersing sweatband integrated into the design is a game-changer for enthusiasts who brave the sun's intensity. It efficiently wicks away sweat, keeping you cool and dry even during strenuous activities. This feature is particularly invaluable for those long days under the sun, be it on a hike, gardening session, or a day out at the beach.
The hat's defining characteristic lies in its generously proportioned bill and neck flap. The large bill not only shields your eyes from harsh sunlight but also offers additional protection to the face, reducing the risk of sunburn and glare. Coupled with this, the mesh nets provide unparalleled ventilation, allowing air to circulate freely around your head, thus preventing heat buildup. This thoughtful inclusion makes it perfect for hot summer days when every breath of fresh air counts.
The neck flap, an extension of the hat's protective coverage, safeguards the sensitive skin on your neck from harmful UV rays. With an adjustable drawstring, you can customize its fit to your liking, ensuring maximum comfort without compromising on style or practicality.
What sets this hat apart further is its packable nature. It effortlessly folds into a compact size, making it incredibly easy to stash in your backpack or luggage without taking up much space. Whether you're setting off on a camping trip, embarking on a tropical vacation, or simply heading to the local pool, this hat becomes your indispensable companion.
Its versatility extends to a myriad of outdoor activities – from leisurely strolls along the beach to adrenaline-pumping fishing expeditions. Gardeners will appreciate its sun-blocking prowess during their daily tending routines, while travelers will find solace in its lightweight yet robust build during their explorations.
In summary, this micro-fiber and mesh adjustable hat is more than just a head covering; it's a versatile tool that enhances your outdoor experience by offering comprehensive sun protection, unmatched breathability, and convenient packability. Embrace the great outdoors this summer with confidence, knowing you're geared up with the perfect accessory for any adventure under the sun.

title: Rachael Ray 14" Nitro Cast Iron Skillet with Side Handle Red
product_description: Meet your new kitchen superhero! This Rachael Ray NITRO Cast Iron Skillet is no ordinary pan. It sears like cast iron, but it’s easier to clean. It’s great with food release, but you don’t need to pre-season. It’s oven safe to 500 degrees F, but it’s also induction ready. This cookware is crafted with an innovative heat treatment that fortifies it at extreme temperatures and infuses it with nitrogen. (That’s why we call it NITRO!) This process seals all the little nooks and crannies in the cast iron, resulting in an exceptionally smooth surface that’s easy to clean and maintain and is ultra resistant to rusting, chipping, and staining. So wash it, scrub it, and turn up the heat! Can your other cast iron do that? We also added nifty features like dual side handles for easy transport from stove to oven to table, dual built-in spouts for easy pouring, and a satin-smooth finish that always looks great. This extra large 14-inch skillet is perfect for big one-pan meals, from eggs, hash browns, and bacon to paella for the whole family to a big batch of brownies or even a deep dish cast iron pizza. Now that’s super!

product_description: The Henckels International Statement Hollow Edge Santoku Knife is perfect for detailed kitchen tasks. Along with the full tang, this encourages maximum maneuverability. The traditional triple-rivet handles are curved for comfort and balance while the stainless steel endcap adds aesthetic appeal to your block display. Each time you cook, you will want to reach for this useful knife set.Henckels International makes essential kitchen tools every home chef needs. From steak knives to spatulas, each product boasts high quality at an exceptional value. Created in 1895 by Zwilling J.A. Henckels, this value-driven brand guarantees the same durability, design and ease of use for which the global company is known. Equip your kitchen with expertise with Henckels International.

title: Swimline Round Overlap Above Ground Pool Liner Standard Gauge with Swirl Bottom Design and LamiClear Protection Against Fading, Blue
product_description:
The above-ground pool liners by Swimline are made up of heavy-duty, 100% virgin vinyl material protected with Lamiclear which protects against chemicals and UV fading. It also boasts the best cold crack resistance in the industry so that your pool liner can withstand the harmful winter weather. You can be sure that pool liners by Swimline are made with high-quality materials and will last long winters and hot summers.

This Overlap liner is made with an elegant swirl bottom design that will add to your pool’s aesthetics. It is also perma-sealed ensuring that you will not experience leakages making for easy maintenance. 

Above ground, swimming pool liner is built to provide years of usage, create a protective barrier for the structure of the pool, and assist in maintaining structural integrity. Swimline ensures that you get the best for your pools. When it comes to making memories on the water, Swimline has you covered.

The Swimline overlap liner requires coping strips to secure pool liner in place, sold separately.

Founded in 1971, Herman Schwimmer built the foundation of Swimline with the goal of bringing a pool to every family in America with high quality pool liners. Almost 50 years and 3 generations later, Swimline has become a world leader in the production of pool liners, pool toys, pool maintenance, and watersports equipment.
